title: Alert notifications
defaultHelp: After activation, only new alerts are queued. Email and browser notifications also require your personal subscription. Settings changes cancel outdated pending messages; messages already being sent may still arrive.
personalHelp: Emails go to your account address. Browser notifications go to your registered browsers. Turning a channel off stops future messages without changing alert rules.
pushOptIn: Receive alerts in my registered browsers
pushPrivacy: Browser notifications hide alert details. Open the app and sign in to view them. Signing out unregisters this browser.
browserHelp: Requires a secure connection, a compatible browser and the production app. On iPhone or iPad, first add the app to your Home Screen.
oldKey: Server keys or account access changed. Remove this subscription and enable the browser again.
settingsHelp: Administrators enable delivery channels. Emails and webhooks include rule and sensor names; browser messages hide these details. Recovery messages are sent only after an opening was accepted, and not when a rule or source was changed or disabled.
includeRecovery: Notify when readings return to normal
serverSetupHelp: Configure connections in Settings → Connections, or through server environment variables. Environment-provided fields are read-only in settings. Webhook formats are generic, ntfy or apprise. Secrets are never displayed.
historyHelp: Shows your messages; administrators also see shared webhook deliveries. Accepted means the service accepted the message, not that it was read. Temporary failures are retried up to five times over 24 hours.

errors.conflict: These settings changed in another session. Reload before saving.
errors.notConfigured: Configure and enable this channel on the server first.
errors.subscriptionInvalid: This browser subscription is not supported.
errors.subscriptionConflict: This subscription cannot be attached to this account. Disable this browser and try again.
errors.subscriptionLimit: At most ten browser subscriptions are allowed. Remove an old one first.
errors.browserUnsupported: This browser or application version does not support push.
errors.permissionDenied: Notification permission was not granted. You can change it in browser settings.
errors.workerUnavailable: The notification worker is not ready. Close other application tabs/windows and reopen the production application.
errors.webhookBlocked: Webhook blocked by destination policy. Check the approved internal hosts/networks.
errors.deliveryFailed: Delivery failed. Temporary errors are retried within the supported limit.
errors.subscriptionExpired: The browser subscription expired and was removed. Enable that browser again.
errors.cancelled: Delivery was cancelled after consent, configuration or account changes, or because it was too old.

validation.channelInvalid: Choose whether to receive notifications through this channel.
validation.recoveryInvalid: Choose whether to send recovery notifications.
